subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “But it also created old problems: carelessness, trust, and honesty.”?
options: A living classroom changes every time students enter it.
The best system knows when to stop pretending it understands and call a human.
The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.
Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A living classroom changes every time students enter it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The best system knows when to stop pretending it understands and call a human.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「But it also created old problems: carelessness, trust, and honesty. Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「But it also created old problems: carelessness, trust, and honesty. Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.」，答案為「Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
